description: Query and display today's hot topics in one shot: fetch a ranked hot list (rank / title / hot value / source) from public, authentication-free hot-list REST APIs over HTTPS (read-only), normalise the results and print them as a readable Markdown table by default (plain text and JSON are also available). Providers are abstracted and tried in order, degrading to a bundled sample dataset — clearly marked as sample data — when the network or every provider is unavailable, so a single run always yields a readable result without crashing. Implemented with the Python 3 standard library only; it does not call the Huawei Cloud CLI, any Huawei Cloud SDK, or any Huawei Cloud REST API, requires no AK/SK credentials, and touches no cloud resource. Triggers include: "查询今日热点", "今日热点榜单", "热门话题", "今日热搜", "热点榜", "daily hot topics", "today hot list", "trending topics".
